description: For non-volatile atomicrmw with a saturating value, mutate the operation to xchg while retaining the operand. Exact integer cases: xchg; or all-ones; and zero; signed min with signed minimum; signed max with signed maximum; unsigned min with unsigned minimum; unsigned max with unsigned maximum. Exact FP cases: fmax +infinity; fmin -infinity; fadd/fsub NaN.
extra_conditions: isSaturating true for one enumerated operation/constant pair
puddle_blocker: The Puddle LLVM dialect has no atomicrmw opcode/interpreter case. Effectful atomic operations would also be rejected by SupportedOpCode, which requires a nonterminating operation with no memory effect.

description: atomicrmw add(ptr, 0 - x) -> atomicrmw sub(ptr, x), and atomicrmw sub(ptr, 0 - x) -> atomicrmw add(ptr, x); mutate operation and value operand.
extra_conditions: value operand matches negation form 0 - x exactly
puddle_blocker: The Puddle LLVM dialect has no atomicrmw opcode/interpreter case. Effectful atomic operations would also be rejected by SupportedOpCode, which requires a nonterminating operation with no memory effect.

description: Canonicalize an idempotent integer atomicrmw to or 0 by mutating operation and operand. Exact recognized cases: add/sub/or/xor with zero; and with all-ones; signed min with signed max; signed max with signed min; unsigned min with unsigned max; unsigned max with unsigned min.
extra_conditions: isIdempotentRMW true for one enumerated operation/constant pair
puddle_blocker: The Puddle LLVM dialect has no atomicrmw opcode/interpreter case. Effectful atomic operations would also be rejected by SupportedOpCode, which requires a nonterminating operation with no memory effect.

description: Canonicalize an idempotent floating atomicrmw to fadd -0.0: fadd -0.0 and fsub +0.0 retain the operand; mutate the operation to fadd and replace the value operand with negative zero.
extra_conditions: operation/value pair is fadd with -0.0 or fsub with +0.0
puddle_blocker: The Puddle LLVM dialect has no atomicrmw opcode/interpreter case. Effectful atomic operations would also be rejected by SupportedOpCode, which requires a nonterminating operation with no memory effect.
